about: Starlets '91 Road's kit (circle-game docs/starlets-91-plan.md, stage 2): the corridor, the road's reference line and segments, the plan's OSM lots with their tags and the plan's typology for the OSM buildings it types (lon, lat; WGS84). Read by scripts/avenue_kit.py; written by scripts/starlets_kit_data.py.
source: The plan's survey of 22 Nov 2026 (its lots, Appendix A, and its table of every building) and OpenStreetMap (API map calls of 23 Nov 2026, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL); the corridor is 150 m either side of either carriageway plus 40 m either side of each cross street's first 250 m.
